name: Ririmu
message: 「I’m telling you！ That’s not it！ It’s not about the stance, it’s about what happens after you step in.」

name: Asahi
message: 「But if you messed up your spacing, you’d get stepped in on, wouldn’t you？ So then...」
Ririmu and Asahi’s heated argument echoed across the training grounds.

name: Momiji
message: 「Huh? Are you two fighting again?」

name: Iori
message: 「No, that’s not it.」
The preliminary rounds of the Martial Festival begin next week. And once the preliminaries are over, the main tournament follows immediately.
This week serves as the final adjustment period before the Martial Festival. Perhaps that is why the two of them are so incredibly fired up.

name: Ririmu
message: 「No, you can’t defend against a rush like that！ You have to think assuming they’re going to step in, right?」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hmm... in that case, the situation becomes quite disadvantageous. But you’re right, it does seem necessary to anticipate that.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yeah, exactly. Look here? Even if you’re pushed, don’t back off！ If they come from the left, you can just dive in and whack them, right?」

name: Asahi
message: 「I see... that might be effective. Though I suppose it depends on the opponent.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Well, as long as you move in a way that makes your opponent think ‘man, this sucks,’ you can adapt it to a certain extent, can’t you？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I mean, Asahi, you’re good at thinking about what people find annoying, right?」

name: Asahi
message: 「Heh heh heh. So that’s how you see me, Ririmu? I’m disappointed.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yeah, yeah, you can be disappointed later, just think about it now.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I’ll leave it at that for now, but should we verify your striking patterns next, Ririmu?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yeah, teach me, teach me!」
The two seem to be trading impressions on each other's matches and performing intensive research.

name: Momiji
message: 「Hey, what happens if they end up facing each other in the Martial Festival?」

name: Iori
message: 「Nothing in particular, I’d imagine. It’s just a matter of both of them going at it with everything they’ve got.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I have a feeling it’s going to get messy, though—having to fight someone who knows all your tricks.」

name: Iori
message: 「Not necessarily. It’s also fun to bank on the fact that your opponent knows your tricks, and then stab them in the back instead.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Oh? Have you ever done that?」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha, of course.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Muragaki-sensei! I’ve brought the data for the matches!」

name: Iori
message: 「Good, let’s take a look. Let’s see here...」
What Setsugekka brought was the data measuring her vitals from when she sparred with Yorishiro-kun.

name: Iori
message: 「...This is incredible. Your psycho-sensory values are skyrocketing.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah, that’s because ever since I fought Shizuku-senpai, I’ve sort of figured out how to use this rampage.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Like, you know how it feels when you pull out that hot, thick, sludge-like stuff from the bottom of your gut, sluuuurp?」

name: Iori
message: 「I-I see... I can’t quite grasp it myself, but you understand it, don't you, Setsugekka？」
To pull out the god within and control it. I wonder if that is what she means by gaining a concrete sense of it.

name: Momiji
message: 「...Isn't that fluctuating like crazy？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hmm, I’ve gotten the hang of pulling it out and putting it away, but...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I just can't quite master riding it yet~」

name: Momiji
message: 「Is that even going to be useful？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「It is! Or rather, I’ll make sure I can use it!」

name: Iori
message: 「I think it’s a remarkable improvement, seeing as you can now suppress it yourself even when you’re about to lose control.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yay, Sensei praised me！」

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, Setsugekka, keep working on your training so you can stably utilize your rampage.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Okaaaay！」
She replied energetically and turned back toward Yorishiro-kun. Setsugekka is definitely the one who has changed the most.

name: Iori
message: 「Ririmu, you're up against Victoria’s Yorishiro-kun. We should make sure you’re fully prepared.」
As for Asahi, her secret training is the main task, but...

name: Iori
message: （Will she really be ready in time for the Martial Festival? I have no choice but to bet on Asahi’s hard work.）
Regardless, Asahi and Ririmu’s progress is excellent. This must be the result of them pushing each other to improve.
Lastly, there’s Momiji, but she was strong to begin with. Her impeccable technique has only been polished further.

name: Iori
message: 「Momiji, how’s your progress？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, it’s going okay, I guess~」
Judging by the sparring data from Yorishiro-kun, Momiji’s results are flawless.

name: Iori
message: 「Hmm, maybe my guidance wasn't necessary at all.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, about the meditation stuff~ I don't think that was really for me.」

name: Iori
message: 「My apologies. I’ve wasted your valuable time.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Th-that, don’t worry about that!」

name: Iori
message: 「Huh？ No, but before, Momiji, you said…」
I had been warned by Momiji.
『‘If you’re going to be involved with me, provide me with meaningful time. If you can’t do that, then I’d rather be alone.’” —That was what she said.

name: Momiji
message: 「A-ah, that was just a fleeting thought! You’ve already given me plenty of precious time, Sensei!」

name: Iori
message: 「Is that so...？ I have absolutely no awareness of it, but what kind of time have I provided to Momiji？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Th-that’s, well... various things, various things.」

name: Iori
message: 「I want to know more specifically.」

name: Momiji
message: 「NO！ I flatly refuse！」
I wonder why she’s so stubborn about it.

name: Momiji
message: 「Anyway！ The Zazen meditation didn’t mean much, but since I’ve gotten plenty of other things from you, let’s call it even.」
Well, if Momiji is fine with that, then I suppose it’s fine.

name: Momiji
message: 「Was there not some other way to reach the state of Shohou Muga？」

name: Iori
message: 「There are, but we’re talking about things like waterfall asceticism or a thousand-day liberation retreat.」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, it’s no exaggeration to say that the state of Shohou Muga is the final, complete form for a swordsman.」

name: Iori
message: 「I hope that years, or even decades from now, it’ll be of some use when Momiji steps into that state.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Years from now? I’ll be an old lady by then. I don’t want to be doing Jindou until I’m that old.」

name: Iori
message: 「What’s this? You don’t intend to be an active competitor for life?」

name: Momiji
message: 「I don’t. I’ll probably quit if I have kids. My mother did the same, after all.」

name: Iori
message: 「I see, Momiji’s child, huh...！」
Kids are great... I’m sure they’d be super adorable, just like Miyako or Tsubaki...！

name: Momiji
message: 「...Wh-what? Miyako might have said something about marriage, but don’t take it seriously, okay!」

name: Iori
message: 「I know. That was just a joke, right？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Mm-muu...」

name: Iori
message: 「Still, we’ve somehow made it this far.」
I look out over the training ground and find myself lost in deep emotion.
I chased after everyone trying to escape the situation where only Asahi was in the classroom, and somehow managed to get them all back together.
I calmed, scolded, and brought together everyone who was saying and doing whatever they pleased.
We somehow cleared the midterm exams, and everyone was successfully selected for the Martial Festival qualifiers.

name: Iori
message: 「Now that we've come this far, we're just going to power through the Martial Festival too.」
I want to make everyone even stronger this coming week. I want to make sure they have a Martial Festival with no regrets.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Phew, I'm wiped！ Hey Teach, can I call it a day？」
Ririmu returned after finishing her battle on Yorishiro-kun.

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, you were moving around quite a bit. Get plenty of rest and give your muscles a break.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Roger that！ Asahi, let's grab something sweet to eat on the way home~」

name: Asahi
message: 「I'm going to stay a little longer for some basic training. I've only been using Yorishiro-kun for a while now.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Huh？ Are you for real？ You're gonna start now？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Of course. Physical strength and muscle never betray you.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You're amazing, Asahi... I seriously respect that. Maybe I'll give it a try too~」

name: Asahi
message: 「I think that's a great idea. Let's definitely do it together.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「By the way, how much are you planning on doing？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Just lightly today, maybe 50 laps running around the school perimeter and 1,000 diving swings.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whaaaat！？ If I do that much, I won't be able to move tomorrow from the muscle soreness！？」

name: Asahi
message: 「It'll be fine, you'll get used to it soon.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「No way, no way, no way! I'm definitely sitting this one out.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehehe, you've already set sail on this ship now. Come on, let's go, Ririmu-san.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Nooo, someone help meee!」

name: Iori
message: 「Asahi~, go easy on her~」
With her arm grabbed by Asahi, Ririmu was dragged out to the training grounds.
